name: Edge Keeps
heights: fields 240 · the basin 220 · keeps 360 · the loch 60 deep · its isle 60

theme.ground: rolling hills of heather and moor grass, peat hags and green flushes in the hollows, bracken on the slopes, grey granite tors and keep cliffs, black peat round the loch, granite-sett causeways.
theme.plants: ad0_fir pinewoods thinning to lone pines, birchtree copses by the loch and in the hollows, ferns as bracken on the slopes.
theme.features: rocks30_def granite tors on the crests, scree under the crags and boulders on the moor, legstone cairns on the keeps, rocks30_moss on the isle.
theme.weather: grey sky, drifting mist; wind 10 to 25; tidal 12.
